about_the_game:
Machine TakeOver is a single-player sandbox survival experience. Guide a lone character through a decaying open world where you’ll scavenge for resources, craft tools and weapons, build modular structures, and, above all, evade the Machines.

Once designed to optimize production, the Machines have redefined their purpose: culture is irrelevant, memory is inefficient, and humanity is no longer at the top of the chain. In this world, every life is measured by its biochemical value, and failure to meet the quota means becoming fuel.

Key Features

– Unforgiving Survival Mechanics

Survival isn’t a gauge; it’s a consequence. Hunger, thirst, infection, and exhaustion are constant threats. Regional damage impacts movement and combat capabilities. Shot in the arm? You can’t aim properly. Wounded in the leg? You’ll limp and lose the ability to run.

– Open World. Limited Mercy.

Roam abandoned towns, industrial ruins, overgrown forests, and Machine-controlled zones. Each region offers unique threats, resources, and strategic dilemmas. Day-night cycles and weather dynamically affect visibility and danger.

– Crafting & Modular Building

Scavenge materials to craft handmade weapons, tools, clothes, and consumables. Build and customize modular structures: walls, frames, barricades; whatever you need to delay your inevitable discovery.

– Human NPC Encounters

Machines aren’t your only threat. Other survivors may trade, beg, deceive, or kill on sight. Form fragile relationships, barter for survival, or walk away… if you can.

– Procedural Traits & RPG Elements

Start each run with randomized traits (e.g., myopia) and adapt your playstyle accordingly. Level up character attributes through practice and experience. No chosen ones, no plot armor.

Will You Survive, or Become Fuel?

Machine TakeOver is a hardcore single-player sandbox where survival means outsmarting merciless Machines in a world ruled by cold efficiency. Humanity is nothing but wasted potential in their perfect system.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics 630 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 2GB / AMD Radeon™ HD 7850 2GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600X
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Survive alone in a sandbox world overrun by AI-driven Machines. Loot, craft, build, and evade. Every hit hurts. Every mistake matters. Machines value no memories, no culture, only biochemical efficiency. Will you survive, or become fuel?

English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
